chunks: Sahl, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from Al-Husayn ibn Umar ibn Yazeed, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Allah forgives during the month of Ramadan except for three: the owner of an intoxicant, or the owner of the two kings (chess), or the bickerer.
ai.seo_question: Who are the three people excluded from Allah's forgiveness in Ramadan according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifies three specific spiritual obstructions that prevent entry into the general mercy of Ramadan: those habituated to intoxicants, players of chess (specifically 'al-shahin' or the two kings), and those prone to persistent quarreling. In Shia jurisprudence, this highlights how recreational pastimes and interpersonal discord can act as barriers to the spiritual purification intended for the month, linking behavioral ethics directly to divine forgiveness.
